title: Pure Nimble
summary: Nimble Level 2 swarm build paired with Swap Frog and Rank 2 / Link-2 Extra Deck payoffs. Sending Nimble Angler from the hand or Deck to the GY immediately Special Summons up to 2 Level 3 or lower Nimble monsters from the Deck, fueling Gigantic Spright, Spright Sprind, Cat Shark, and Toadally Awesome.

summary.title: Starters
points: Nimble Beaver Special Summons a Level 3 or lower Nimble monster from your Deck or GY when Normal Summoned, assembling a 1-card Rank 2 Xyz or Link-2.
Swap Frog discards a WATER monster (such as Nimble Angler) from the hand to Special Summon itself, then sends a Level 2 or lower WATER Aqua (or Nimble Angler) from the Deck to the GY on summon.
Foolish Burial (Limited) sends Nimble Angler directly from the Deck to the GY to summon two Nimbles without using your Normal Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Swap Frog + Nimble Angler
steps: Discard Nimble Angler from the hand to Special Summon Swap Frog; Angler's mandatory GY trigger Special Summons 2 Nimble Beaver from the Deck while Swap Frog sends a second Nimble Angler (or another Swap Frog) to the GY.
Link Summon Spright Sprind using a Level 2 and another monster to send another Nimble Angler from the Deck to the GY, summoning 2 more Nimbles.

Overlay two Level 2s (including a Link-2 if desired for 3200 base ATK) into Gigantic Spright to detach and summon a second Swap Frog from the Deck, then make Toadally Awesome, Cat Shark, and I:P Masquerena.

summary.title: Nimble Angler & Battle Floaters
summary.text: Nimble Angler triggers whenever it is sent from the hand or Deck to the GY (note that being sent as a cost from the hand, such as for Swap Frog, must be Chain Link 1 or not miss timing, whereas being sent by card effect like Foolish Burial or Spright Sprind always triggers as a mandatory effect) to summon up to 2 Level 3 or lower Nimbles from the Deck. Nimble Sunfish sends a Fish (Nimble Angler) from the Deck to the GY and replaces itself when destroyed by battle, Nimble Manta swarms copies when sent from the field to the GY by card effect, and Nimble Momonga gains 1000 LP and Sets up to 2 copies from the Deck when destroyed by battle.

summary.title: Extra Deck & Payoff
points: Toadally Awesome (made with two Level 2 Aqua Swap Frogs) sends an Aqua from the hand or field to the GY to negate any card or effect activation and Set the negated card to your field, then recovers a WATER monster when sent to the GY.

Gigantic Spright doubles its original ATK to 3200 when made with a Link-2 material and detaches to Special Summon any Level 2 monster from the Deck (locking both players to Level/Rank/Link 2 monsters for the rest of the turn).

Cat Shark cannot be destroyed by battle while holding a WATER material and detaches as a Quick Effect to double a Rank 4 or lower Xyz Monster's original ATK (boosting a Link-made Gigantic Spright to 6400 ATK).
Marincess Coral Anemone revives a WATER monster with 1500 or less ATK from the GY, and I:P Masquerena links into S:P Little Knight or Knightmare Unicorn on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Spells
points: Surface revives any Level 3 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster (Nimble Angler, Sunfish, Manta, or Swap Frog) from the GY in Defense Position.
Moray of Greed shuffles 2 WATER monsters (extra copies of Angler, Sunfish, or Manta that you want in the Deck rather than drawn) from your hand back into the Deck to draw 3 cards.

Level 2 WATER Fish: when sent from the field to the GY by a card effect, Special Summons any number of 'Nimble Manta' from your Deck.
Iconic Level 2 EARTH Beast: when destroyed by battle, gains 1000 LP and Special Summons up to 2 'Nimble Momonga' from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

Link-2: banishes a card on the field/GY on summon and banishes 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.
